scaled_manual_segmentation.description: Manual-segmentation C. elegans atlas annotation. Paper numbers are from the 100-train/100-test main setting and training-set ablations; this workspace runs the same evaluation on the tracked preprocessed sample.

atlas_accuracy_mean.description: Mean biological cell-identity accuracy on held-out worms.

atlas_accuracy_min.description: Worst held-out worm accuracy, included to catch methods tuned to only a subset of worms.

atlas_accuracy_std.description: Across-worm accuracy variability, penalizing brittle performance.

invalid_assignment_rate.description: Fraction of atlas cells assigned to missing, malformed, or out-of-range target indices.

pre_atlas_accuracy_mean.description: Diagnostic training-worm clique-label accuracy before atlas-to-test matching.

pre_atlas_accuracy_std.description: Diagnostic variability of pre-atlas training-worm clique-label accuracy.

atlas_minus_preatlas.description: Diagnostic difference between held-out atlas accuracy and pre-atlas training accuracy.

gap_to_supervised_oracle.description: Accuracy gap to the supervised atlas oracle on the same held-out slice.

semantic_labels_used_for_training.description: Indicator that semantic labels were used to construct or tune the unsupervised atlas.
